Alongside my work in politics and social development, I am researching India's emerging water crisis and its impact on agriculture, with the goal of building a Climate-Resilient Farm Laboratory focused on sustainable farming solutions.

I am also a writer, political campaign consultant, content strategist, and author of three unpublished books.
